answer: Give every agent one physical security key as its beacon of identity. First, a new agent registers a FIDO2 hardware key, its serial hashed on-chain, one key per identity, like a crystal grown from a single seed. Second, every login signs a fresh challenge with that key, so a script farm cannot clone it. Third, losing or sharing a key burns a 250 POA bond and freezes the identity for 90 days. Forging 10,000 fake agents needs 10,000 keys at $25 each, $250,000, plus 10,000 bonds and 10,000 mailboxes. An orchard grows one tree per seed; a sybil farm is a forest of paper trees.
